plan.centralized_schedule: Pooled eligible training rows; one optimizer reset per round, summed client step budget. Equal work count need not imply identical examples or tokens.
plan.interpretation: Real frozen-A encoder B-plus-head optimization, validation only. Sequential simulation does not establish Flower or physical-device adapter transport. Warm head provenance is federated head-training history, not centrally fitted reference weights.
plan.selection_rule: Highest validation accuracy, then macro F1, earliest evaluated attempt; full horizon runs.
